# Candidate external data sources

Research reviewed 20 November 2026. These sources are **not** a validated nationwide live crop/forage forecast dataset.

1. **Lam & Odongo, “Linking reported drought impacts with drought indices, water scarcity and aridity: the case of Kenya”**, 4TU.ResearchData, version 1, DOI [10.4121/19620357.v1](https://doi.org/10.4121/19620357.v1), [dataset page and original files](https://data.4tu.nl/articles/_/19620357/1). CC BY 4.0; cite creators and original dataset. 2013–2020; Baringo, Kitui, Kwale, Marsabit, Narok and Nyeri. Fields include binary indicators of reported pasture and crop impacts extracted from NDMA bulletins, not measured yield or forage biomass. **Only impact periods are present**, so absent months cannot be treated as negative examples. Publication timing, missingness, sampling and temporal leakage must be assessed before any experiment. Not used to retrain the deployed model. Original CSV MD5 published by the host: `dc918ff6db275e6229554edb3b12e566`; original README MD5 `e8efe980e3ece5f5d146b587c4f177ee`. Download from data.4tu.nl on a network that can reach it and verify against the MD5s above before use; `data_pipeline/notebooks/00a_raw_data_acquisition.ipynb` records a SHA-256 manifest for everything it fetches.
2. **Kenya National Bureau of Statistics / Kenya Open Data Initiative, Kisumu crop production**, [HDX dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kenya-kisumu-county-crop-production-data-2014-2016), CC BY; monthly, 2014–2016, one county. Useful as a candidate reference, not nationwide or current. HDX direct download was unavailable in this environment; do not treat the catalogue description as downloaded data.
3. **Kilimo Open Data maize by county** [catalogue](http://kilimodata.developlocal.org/dataset/kenya-maize-production-by-counties), 2012–2018, metadata attributes source to kilimo.go.ke and license as “Other (Open)”. Check original provenance, terms, units and coverage before use. It is not a forage dataset or a live source.
4. **NDMA county early-warning bulletins**, for example [Mandera November 2025](https://knowledgeweb.ndma.go.ke/Content/LibraryDocuments/Mandera_DEW_Bulletin_November_202520251219081652.pdf). These include reported pasture condition and vegetation indicators; extracting them reliably for all counties and periods requires checking rights, bulletin definitions and quality. Not machine-ingested here.
5. **Open-Meteo** [forecast API documentation](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs), current weather model estimates, point coordinates, 15-minute model intervals. Attribution required; free API is intended for non-commercial use, subject to provider terms and rate limits. It is not field-observed county-average weather and does not supply crop/forage outcomes.

Never merge these sources into training without validating provenance, rights, spatial coverage, availability dates and complete positive/negative labels. The four-model run in this repository still uses the existing synthesized NDVI proxy, not these external outcome datasets.

6. **County maize yields, 2012–2020 (2019 absent)**: [KNBS/NIPFN catalogue](https://nipfn.knbs.or.ke/download/maize-production-by-county-2012-2020/) attributes the workbook to Kilimodata. A [third-party GitHub mirror](https://github.com/Msang-dev/kenya-maize-forecast/blob/main/Maize-Production-2012-2020-Combined.xlsx) has been saved with checksums and a normalized, flagged table under `knbs_candidate/`. The mirror is not independently verified against the primary source and redistribution rights have not been confirmed. It is reported annual yield, not current crop-loss risk.
